title: Trans-CTGAN: Improving Correlation Preservation in Tabular GANs
summary: This is a research repository that proposes Trans-CTGAN, an enhanced version of CTGAN adding Transformer encoder modules and residual connections to better capture inter-column correlations in tabular data synthesis. It vendors the CTGAN source in-tree to build the new EnhancedCTGAN model and also runs SDV's single-table API (CTGANSynthesizer, Metadata, evaluate_quality, run_diagnostic) in comparison notebooks as a baseline and evaluation harness.
evidence: Sourcecodes/CTGAN-main/CTGAN-main/test1.ipynb:10 'from ctgan import CTGAN,EnhancedCTGAN'; vendored ctgan/ dir extended into Trans-CTGAN
needs: SDV's single_table CTGANSynthesizer/Metadata/evaluate_quality calls appear only in baseline notebooks separate from the core vendored+extended CTGAN codebase; both usages coexist but serve different roles.
